regions.name: HeavyStickyMisaligned
regions.rationale: Heavy, high-friction cube placed far forward and sideways with noisy perception and actuation delay likely causes missed pick and wall collision.

regions.name: LightSlipperyOffTarget
regions.rationale: Very light, low-friction cube positioned far backward and sideways with minimal noise but high positional offset leads to slipping and missed placement.

regions.name: HighNoiseLargeDelay
regions.rationale: Moderate mass and friction with high sensor noise combined with a large actuation delay makes the controller misjudge placement timing.

regions.name: TallWallCollision
regions.rationale: Tall, heavy cube placed near the wall with low sensor noise but small actuation delay can cause the arm to strike the wall before clearing the obstacle.

regions.name: EdgeSizeExtremeNoise
regions.rationale: Cubes at the extreme edge of size with high position noise create unpredictable geometry that can trap the gripper or miss the target.
